relevant_files.role: Language registry and LanguageInfo struct definition
Reference implementation with ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, extract_inheritance

conventions.commits: Conventional commits with SPDX license headers (Apache-2.0); DCO enforced
conventions.testing: Unit tests in each language module; integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/; test functions verify ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, extract_inheritance, and handler functions
conventions.linting: clippy with -D warnings; deny undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (test-code exemptions via cfg_attr)
conventions.error_handling: thiserror for error types; Option/Result patterns; bounds checking on node.end_byte() <= source.len()

patterns: Language modules export const ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, and optional DEFUSE_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, IMPL_QUERY, IMPL_TRAIT_QUERY
LanguageInfo struct registered in get_language_info() match arm with tree-sitter language binding and all query strings
Extension map in lang.rs maps file extensions to language identifiers; get_ts_language() provides tree-sitter Language binding
extract_inheritance, extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver are optional handler functions
DEFUSE_QUERY captures write sites (local declarations, assignments) and read sites (identifier usage) with @write.* and @read.* tags
Tests use tree_sitter::Parser, tree_sitter::Query, tree_sitter::QueryCursor to verify query compilation and node extraction
constraints: All languages are unconditionally compiled in; historical lang-* feature gates removed
tree-sitter-php must be added to workspace dependencies (Cargo.toml) and crate dependencies (crates/aptu-coder-core/Cargo.toml)
PHP extension (.php) must be added to EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs
PHP language identifier must be added to supported_languages() slice in lang.rs
extract_inheritance is required for class-based languages; defuse_query is optional but recommended for semantic analysis
test_coverage: Existing tests for Java, Kotlin, Python verify: (1) ELEMENT_QUERY matches all declaration kinds; (2) extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver extract correct identifiers; (3) extract_inheritance captures extends and implements clauses; (4) DEFUSE_QUERY captures write and read sites. Integration tests verify language registration and file extension mapping.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE; grammar defines function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration; inheritance via base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) nodes
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar uses 'name' field for all declarations; base_clause and class_interface_clause are child nodes (not fields) of class_declaration; method_declaration appears inside declaration_list body; function_definition is top-level

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter::Query, tree_sitter::QueryCursor, tree_sitter::Language, Node::child_by_field_name(), Node::parent(), Node::kind()
library_findings.notes: Query syntax uses S-expression patterns with @capture tags; field names must match grammar definition exactly; child_by_field_name() retrieves named fields; parent() walks up AST

approaches.name: Approach 1: Minimal PHP support (CSS-like pattern)
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php dependency, create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY only; register in mod.rs and lang.rs with no inheritance or defuse handlers. Suitable if only symbol discovery is needed.
pros: Follows CSS pattern already in codebase
cons: Limited semantic value for code agents

approaches.name: Approach 2: Full PHP support with inheritance and DEFUSE_QUERY
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php dependency, create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums), DEFUSE_QUERY (local declarations, assignments, identifier reads), extract_inheritance handler (walk base_clause and class_interface_clause nodes), extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver handlers. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Include 9+ unit tests covering all dimensions.
pros: Enables inheritance analysis for code agents
cons: More complex inheritance walk (base_clause/class_interface_clause are children, not fields)

approaches.name: Approach 3: PHP with optional trait support
approaches.description: Extend Approach 2 to explicitly capture trait_declaration in ELEMENT_QUERY and extract trait use via trait_use_clause nodes (if present in grammar). Add separate test dimension for trait resolution. Requires grammar inspection to confirm trait_use_clause structure.
pros: Covers PHP-specific trait pattern (not in Java/Kotlin)
Demonstrates pattern for future languages with mixins
cons: Requires additional grammar research for trait_use_clause
May need additional handler function if trait resolution is complex

recommendation: Approach 2 (Full PHP support with inheritance and DEFUSE_QUERY). Rationale: (1) Issue #1864 requests 'add PHP language support' without specifying minimal scope; (2) existing Java/Kotlin implementations include inheritance and defuse handlers, establishing a pattern; (3) defuse_query is marked 'required' in Step 6 because semantic analysis (def-use tracking) is a core feature of aptu-coder; (4) extract_inheritance enables code agents to reason about class hierarchies, a key use case; (5) comprehensive test coverage (9+ dimensions) matches existing language test patterns and reduces maintenance burden. Approach 2 is the minimal sufficient implementation to match the codebase's semantic completeness standard.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
pub const ELEMENT_QUERY: &str = r"
(function_definition
  name: (name) @function_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(trait_declaration
  name: (name) @trait_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
";
defuse_query_draft:
pub const DEFUSE_QUERY: &str = r"
(simple_parameter name: (variable_name (name)) @write.param)
(property_element name: (variable_name (name)) @write.property)
(assignment_expression left: (variable_name (name)) @write.assign)
(variable_name (name)) @read.usage
";
inheritance_walk_citation: For a class_declaration node, walk its children (not fields, as base_clause and class_interface_clause are child nodes, not named fields per node-types.json): (1) find child node of kind 'base_clause' (represents 'extends'); (2) iterate its named children to extract each 'name' node as an extended class; (3) find child node of kind 'class_interface_clause' (represents 'implements'); (4) iterate its named children to extract each 'name' node as an implemented interface. Source: tree-sitter-php grammar at https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php/blob/master/common/define-grammar.js defines base_clause as seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1($._name)) and class_interface_clause as seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1($._name)); node-types.json confirms class_declaration has only fields 'attributes', 'body', 'name' with no parent_class/interfaces fields.
